description: This file defines a RuntimeCache class that manages a cache of runtime states identified by actor keys, providing methods for accessing, updating, clearing, and snapshotting cache entries, including idle time management.

classes.name: RuntimeCache
classes.description: A class that manages a cache of runtime states, allowing for retrieval, updating, snapshotting, and idle candidate collection based on actor keys.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries currently in the cache.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for the specified actor key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for a given actor key, updating last touched time unless specified not to.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime state for a given actor key without updating its last touched time.

methods.name: getLastTouchedAt
methods.description: Returns the last touched timestamp for a specific actor key, or null if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or updates the cache entry for an actor key with the given runtime state and current time.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the cache entry associated with the specified actor key.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot array of all cache entries including idle time calculations.

methods.name: collectIdleCandidates
methods.description: Collects cache entries that have been idle longer than the specified maximum idle time.

ctags.name: cache
ctags.pattern: /^  private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();$/

fields.name: private readonly cache = new Map<string, RuntimeCacheEntry>();
